dialogues.speaker: Jalade
dialogues.text: I can't really go to Romaritime Harbor. It's directly adjacent to the desert, and my friend who works there told me that the wind is always blowing in a bunch of sand.

dialogues.speaker: Jalade
dialogues.text: If I get blasted by that wind for too long, my skin would surely become a grotesque horror show.

dialogues.speaker: Jalade
dialogues.text: I suppose if all else fails, I can always look for a job back in the city...
